name: search_text
description: Search the contents of text files in the workspace for lines matching a regular expression. Returns matching lines with their file path and 1-based line number. Searches all searchable files unless paths are given.

detailed: Searches text files for lines matching a regular expression.
whimsical: Dig up the words you seek.

detailed: tool {participantRole} is searching file contents for a pattern

pattern.description: Regular expression to match against each line.

paths.description: Optional list of workspace-relative paths to search. A path may be a file or a directory (searched recursively). If omitted, the whole workspace is searched.
